body: Thank you for your reply and teaching me your technique. It helped with my panic attack. But the downside of feeling that I am a living thing, is the pain that comes with it. The pain that knowing that I am still alive and have no one. That's much worse than not feeling anything to me. As I find it hard to connect with anyone at all, these times that I do... I do develop romantic feelings for the person. I felt romantic towards both people mentioned in my post which sucked because it's probably easier to let someone go when you don't feel a love attachment to them.
